acceptance_criteria.covers: versioned PASS/FAIL report with backup identity, digest, environment, checks and postconditions
migrations 001-009 objects plus present functions, triggers, RPCs, policies, grants, RLS, Realtime, identity and audit/event objects
real restore drill in isolated local/preview destination
private access and ownership/RLS evidence without raw private rows or secrets
negative cases produce FAIL and block dependent work

evidence_items.description: mechanism/version, UTC time, source environment/project, backup ID and digest, responsible operator
tables from migrations 001-009, functions, triggers, RPCs, policies, grants, RLS, Realtime, identity and audit/events; explicit verified N/A reasons
real restore into isolated local/preview destination; production cannot be destination
schema, columns/types, keys, constraints, indexes, functions/triggers/RPCs, RLS/policies/grants, Realtime, row counts and deterministic ownership digest
privileged/authenticated read verification without raw rows and no new anonymous private access
missing/corrupt backup, missing object, mismatch, non-isolated destination, unverifiable pooler, new anon access and secret exposure all yield FAIL
recovery procedure does not reopen anonymous private access

human_operations: Use the managed backup mechanism with authorized operational credentials.
Perform the real restore drill in isolated local or preview infrastructure.
Run object, ownership, access, RLS, Realtime and negative-case checks.
Store protected backup/report artifacts outside the repository and provide redacted references and hashes.
orchestrator_forbidden_operations: Supabase remote SQL, db push, reset, deploy or backfill
reading, storing or printing secrets, credentials, cookies, tokens or raw private rows

postconditions.description: restore destination is local/preview and not production
required object comparisons pass or have verified N/A reasons
authenticated/privileged access verified without raw private rows
no new anonymous private access introduced
